//: A file icon theme that gives .cx files the CScript mark and leaves everything else to VS Code's defaults. Shipping a theme is the only way an extension can set a file icon: the icon in the explorer comes from whichever theme is active, and an extension cannot add one to a theme it does not own.
//braces: Two variants, because the braces sit on whatever the editor's background happens to be. Dark braces vanish on a dark theme and light ones vanish on a light theme, so each gets the pair drawn for it. The faceted C is the same in both — it carries its own colour.
